coverage: Formal candidate/follow-up/deferred headings in current product and planning documents, their top-level list items, and per-order decision records. Archive snapshots, refutation receipts, private intake and unstructured legacy prose are not claimed as reconciled.
limits: Source-document bytes are an inventory comparison, not an observed previous planner startup.
The remaining planner-context candidate stays open until measured live evidence shows whether the feed is sufficient.
Untriaged does not assert that a historical suggestion is actionable or still unallocated.
